hotels.title: Brand-New Maldives Overwater Luxury Villas with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Cocktails
hotels.description: Be among the first to discover one of the Maldives’ most exciting five-star grand openings - a brand-new island escape where luxury meets barefoot ease. Wake to the gentle sound of the waves and dive straight into a crystal-clear lagoon from your private overwater villa. Whether your days are spent snorkelling vibrant reefs, gliding across calm waters or simply unwinding by the infinity pool with endless ocean views, every day offers effortless island living. A daily highlight awaits in the resort’s exceptional dining scene - feast on flame-grilled seafood and Mediterranean fare at Bluefin, savour international favourites at The Gallery’s live cooking stations and sip curated cocktails at Sunset Social as the sky melts into shades of pink. Upgrade to an all-inclusive experience and enjoy ultimate indulgence, where all meals, premium drinks and daily adventures are all taken care of. As twilight falls, watch dhonis drift across the horizon from your overwater villa's private deck or set sail on an included sunset dolphin cruise.

hotels.title: Maldives Private Island Bliss with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Roundtrip Speedboat Transfers
hotels.description: Experience true Maldivian magic at the Centara Mirage Lagoon, a private island oasis just 40 minutes from Malé. Sublime cuisine headlines this tropical gem, from freshly caught seafood at Acqua to authentic Thai flavours at the signature Suan Bua, where you can indulge in a private banquet or sip on cocktails at the vibrant Mirage Beach Bar. From sunrise to sunset, there's no shortage of entertainment for all - spend your days floating in the crystal-clear lagoon or dive into the thrill of the lazy river and water park. For couples and honeymooners, romance takes centre stage with sunset cruises, candlelit dinners and private villa picnics, while the acclaimed SPA Cenvaree offers next-level relaxation, complete with the magical Candy Spa to keep the little ones busy. With convenient speedboat transfers included in your package, arriving at Centara Mirage Lagoon couldn't be easier, allowing you to make the most of your trip from the moment you land in Malé. Admire the endless blue of the Indian Ocean as you glide seamlessly to your private slice of heaven, where your journey into bliss begins.
